simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַלּוּחַ (H4408) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מַלּוּחַ (mallûwach) means sea-purslain (from its saltness) First listed occurrence: Job 30 4.

definitions.full: H4408. malluach מַלּוּחַ noun [masculine] mallow; plant growing in salt-marsh ; Job 30:4 (compare Now Archaeology i. 67, 112 ).
